rulesTestNames: lets any live account with access read the header, and no one else
read: any account with live access to the programme gets it by id through its programAccessViews document, while not deleted; never listed
write: server only; written from the programme
migrationNotes: Exactly the programme fields getProgramWorkAccess returns: title, kind, zone, status, capabilities and vehicle classes. The program-work-views copy-forward migration creates summaries for programmes that predate the trigger.
The sender connection, entitlement, branding and request hash stay in organizerPrograms.
